Package org.geysermc.paletter.internal.behaviour

Class BehaviourStore.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.internal.behaviour.BehaviourStore.Builder
Enclosing class:
BehaviourStore
public static final class BehaviourStore.Builder extends Object
Collects captures in application order and stores each key's values as changes. Used by the importer.

      public @NonNull BehaviourStore.Builder postProcessed(@NonNull BehaviourKey<?> key, int capture, @NonNull Collection<?> ids, @NonNull String note)

    • dispute

      public <T> @NonNull BehaviourStore.Builder dispute(@NonNull BehaviourKey<T> key, int capture, int altCapture, @NonNull Map<?,T> values)
      Says that another capture, altCapture, gave other values than the capture that decided, and that nothing direct from BDS settles which is right. It is a capture of the same version, or of another one if the deciding capture's value is the same as in the version where the dispute was seen.
      Parameters:
      values - the alternative value of every disputed id the capture covers

    • defaultOf

      public <T> @NonNull BehaviourStore.Builder defaultOf(@NonNull BehaviourKey<T> key, @NonNull T value, @NonNull Provenance.Source source, @NonNull String reference)
      Sets the BDS default of a key for custom content that does not set the component. Without it the default is unknown.
